_comment: Versioned driver manifest for Khanary-V1 GPU inference stack. Keep in sync with tools/config.py.

inference_server.note: HTTP backend — gen.py default. Used when llama-server is already running.

python_backend.note: Used by gen.py --local. llama-cpp-python handles model loading; torch-directml provides DirectML GPU acceleration on Windows iGPU/dGPU without CUDA.

node_backend.note: Node.js inference path. WebGL2 added to Node for GPU acceleration — covers any GPU with a WebGL2 driver (iGPU included).
node_backend.usage: import { getLlama } from 'node-llama-cpp'; const llama = await getLlama({ gpu: 'webgl' });

coder.role: code generator — returns complete working file
